why: owner 27 Nov: 1.2.2 draft with the update/new tags, the buffs switch with a preview and the combat option

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.2.2-beta (draft) for WoW Forever 1.60.1 (game build 71139)

New
- Two tags in the settings. NEW (orange) = a page or section that is new. UPDATE (green) = an old page or section that got something new or changed inside. A page tag goes away once the page is opened, a section tag once you use a row of that section.
- The buffs and debuffs switch moved to the Game windows page, in its own section, with a live preview (a real buff tooltip).
- Persian in combat (experimental, OFF by default) on the Quests page: the quest list and tracker lines are written during a fight, only on lines with no protected frame above them. Off: they wait for the end of the fight, as before.
- The report now says which guard held a write back during a fight (a line like combatskip :: tracker :: x3), so the next report names what stays English in combat.

From the earlier 1.2.2 drafts
- A click on the floating report icon opens a small page stuck to the icon.
- Buffs that never reached the report are found now.
- The game windows switch is OFF by default.
- Auction house without the English flash, with its own switch.

This build is for testing in game. Nothing of the game is written, and nothing runs in combat unless the combat option is turned on.
